about: Lanoxin (digoxin), by brand name only, is supplied four times from December 2025 to September 2026 to a 75-year-old woman.
Sigmaxin (digoxin) is supplied twice, in January and April 2026, to a 73-year-old man, in the middle of a 14-month history.
Bicor (bisoprolol), a beta-blocker that the source suggests as an alternative, is supplied throughout and no digoxin or other heart glycoside is supplied, so the criterion is not met.
